title: Company row
description: One row of a data/<country>/<state>/<region>.csv file. Every CSV cell is a string, and an empty cell is an empty string. The column order of the CSV header is the order of x-columns.

id.description: Stable slug, unique across the whole repo. Never reuse or rename one.

name.description: Company name as the company writes it.

website.description: Company home page, https, ending in a slash, no path.

careers_url.description: Optional. The company's own careers or jobs page, https, not a job board.

field.description: Optional. A field listed for that industry in schema/industries.csv.

city.description: City of this location, as the source gives it. For a site on a military base, arsenal, test range or space center, the installation name, with abbreviations spelled out, such as Air Force Base, not AFB.

ee_relevant.description: Optional. true when the company's business is hardware, power, RF, embedded, controls, or software engineering, or a cited page shows such roles. Empty otherwise.

source_url.description: Public page that backs the row, usually the company's own site.

last_verified.description: Date someone last checked the row against source_url, YYYY-MM-DD.

notes.description: Optional. Short and neutral. No personal names or contact details.
